quotes.he: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֵת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֵת הָאָרֶץ׃
quotes.tr: Bereshit bara Elohim et hashamayim ve'et ha'aretz
quotes.en: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
quotes.why: The Torah opens with its first word, Bereshit, "in the beginning." Everything that follows starts here: the world has a Maker, and it did not come about by chance.

quotes.he: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים יְהִי אוֹר וַיְהִי־אוֹר׃
quotes.tr: Vayomer Elohim yehi or vayhi-or
quotes.en: And God said: ‘Let there be light.’ And there was light.
quotes.why: The first thing God makes is light, and He makes it with words. In Judaism speech has real power, so the words we choose each day matter.

quotes.he: וַיִּבְרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הָאָדָם בְּצַלְמוֹ בְּצֶלֶם אֱלֹהִים בָּרָא אֹתוֹ זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה בָּרָא אֹתָם׃
quotes.tr: Vayivra Elohim et-ha'adam betzalmo betzelem Elohim bara oto zakhar unekevah bara otam
quotes.en: And God created man in His own image, in the image of God created He him; male and female created He them.
quotes.why: Every person is made in the image of God. That is why each human life has worth, whoever the person is and wherever they come from.

quotes.he: וַיַּרְא אֱלֹהִים אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְהִנֵּה־טוֹב מְאֹד וַיְהִי־עֶרֶב וַיְהִי־בֹקֶר יוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי׃
quotes.tr: Vayar Elohim et-kol-asher asah vehineh-tov me'od vayhi-erev vayhi-voker yom hashishi
quotes.en: And God saw every thing that He had made, and, behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
quotes.why: After each day God saw that it was good. On the sixth day, with people in the world, it became "very good." Look for the good in your own day.

quotes.he: וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת׃
quotes.tr: Vayvarekh Elohim et-yom hashevi'i vaykadesh oto ki vo shavat mikol-melakhto asher-bara Elohim la'asot
quotes.en: And God blessed the seventh day, and hallowed it; because that in it He rested from all His work which God in creating had made.
quotes.why: This is the first Shabbat. God rested on the seventh day and made it holy, and we rest on it too. Shabbat is a gift of time, not only a rule.

quotes.he: וַיִּקַּח יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הָאָדָם וַיַּנִּחֵהוּ בְגַן־עֵדֶן לְעָבְדָהּ וּלְשָׁמְרָהּ׃
quotes.tr: Vayikach Adonai Elohim et-ha'adam vayanichehu vegan-eden le'avedah uleshamerah
quotes.en: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
quotes.why: Adam was put in the garden to work it and to guard it. The earth is placed in our care, and looking after it is part of our job.

quotes.he: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים לֹא־טוֹב הֱיוֹת הָאָדָם לְבַדּוֹ אֶעֱשֶׂהּ־לּוֹ עֵזֶר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ׃
quotes.tr: Vayomer Adonai Elohim lo-tov heyot ha'adam levado e'eseh-lo ezer kenegdo
quotes.en: And the LORD God said: ‘It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help meet for him.’
quotes.why: "It is not good to be alone." People need each other. Community, friendship and family are part of how we were made.

quotes.he: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־קַיִן אֵי הֶבֶל אָחִיךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא יָדַעְתִּי הֲשֹׁמֵר אָחִי אָנֹכִי׃
quotes.tr: Vayomer Adonai el-kayin ei hevel achikha vayomer lo yadati hashomer achi anokhi
quotes.en: And the LORD said unto Cain: ‘Where is Abel thy brother?’ And he said: ‘I know not; am I my brother’s keeper?’
quotes.why: Cain asks, "Am I my brother's keeper?" The rest of the Torah answers yes. We are responsible for one another.

quotes.he: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־אַבְרָם לֶךְ־לְךָ מֵאַרְצְךָ וּמִמּוֹלַדְתְּךָ וּמִבֵּית אָבִיךָ אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַרְאֶךָּ׃
quotes.tr: Vayomer Adonai el-Avram lekh-lekha me'artzekha umimoladtekha umibeit avikha el-ha'aretz asher ar'eka
quotes.en: Now the LORD said unto Abram: ‘Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto the land that I will show thee.
quotes.why: Lech lecha: "go for yourself." Abraham leaves everything familiar to follow God. Every new start, including learning Hebrew, takes a first step like this.

quotes.he: וְאֶעֶשְׂךָ לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל וַאֲבָרֶכְךָ וַאֲגַדְּלָה שְׁמֶךָ וֶהְיֵה בְּרָכָה׃
quotes.tr: Ve'e'eskha legoy gadol va'avarekhkha va'agadelah shemekha vehyeh berakhah
quotes.en: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and be thou a blessing.
quotes.why: Abraham is told not only that he will be blessed but that he will be a blessing. A good life is one that brings good to others.

quotes.he: וַיּוֹצֵא אֹתוֹ הַחוּצָה וַיֹּאמֶר הַבֶּט־נָא הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וּסְפֹר הַכּוֹכָבִים אִם־תּוּכַל לִסְפֹּר אֹתָם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה יִהְיֶה זַרְעֶךָ׃
quotes.tr: Vayotze oto hachutzah vayomer habet-na hashamaymah usefor hakokhavim im-tukhal lispor otam vayomer lo koh yihyeh zar'ekha
quotes.en: And He brought him forth abroad, and said: ‘Look now toward heaven, and count the stars, if thou be able to count them’; and He said unto him: ‘So shall thy seed be.’
quotes.why: God takes Abraham outside to count the stars. When things feel small or uncertain, step back and look at the bigger picture.

quotes.he: חָלִלָה לְּךָ מֵעֲשֹׂת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה לְהָמִית צַדִּיק עִם־רָשָׁע וְהָיָה כַצַדִּיק כָּרָשָׁע חָלִלָה לָּךְ הֲשֹׁפֵט כָּל־הָאָרֶץ לֹא יַעֲשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט׃
quotes.tr: Chalilah lekha me'asot kadavar hazeh lehamit tzadik im-rasha vehayah khatzadik karasha chalilah lakh hashofet kol-ha'aretz lo ya'aseh mishpat
quotes.en: That be far from Thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked, that so the righteous should be as the wicked; that be far from Thee; shall not the judge of all the earth do justly?’
quotes.why: Abraham argues with God to save the people of Sodom. In Jewish tradition it is right to speak up for justice, even before the highest authority.

quotes.he: וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ וּשְׁמַרְתִּיךָ בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר־תֵּלֵךְ וַהֲשִׁבֹתִיךָ אֶל־הָאֲדָמָה הַזֹּאת כִּי לֹא אֶעֱזָבְךָ עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם־עָשִׂיתִי אֵת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתִּי לָךְ׃
quotes.tr: Vehineh anokhi imakh ushemartikha bekhol asher-telekh vahashivotikha el-ha'adamah hazot ki lo e'ezavekha ad asher im-asiti et asher-dibarti lakh
quotes.en: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee whithersoever thou goest, and will bring thee back into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.’
quotes.why: Jacob is alone and running away, and God promises: I am with you, wherever you go. You are never as alone as you feel.

quotes.he: וַיִּיקַץ יַעֲקֹב מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אָכֵן יֵשׁ יְהוָה בַּמָּקוֹם הַזֶּה וְאָנֹכִי לֹא יָדָעְתִּי׃
quotes.tr: Vayikatz Ya'akov mishenato vayomer akhen yesh Adonai bamakom hazeh ve'anokhi lo yada'eti
quotes.en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said: ‘Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.’
quotes.why: Jacob wakes from his dream and says God was in this place and he did not know it. Holiness can be right where you are, if you notice it.

quotes.he: קָטֹנְתִּי מִכֹּל הַחֲסָדִים וּמִכָּל־הָאֱמֶת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי בְמַקְלִי עָבַרְתִּי אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן הַזֶּה וְעַתָּה הָיִיתִי לִשְׁנֵי מַחֲנוֹת׃
quotes.tr: Katoneti mikol hachasadim umikol-ha'emet asher asita et-avdekha ki vemakli avarti et-hayarden hazeh ve'atah hayiti lishnei machanot
quotes.en: I am not worthy of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which Thou hast shown unto Thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two camps.
quotes.why: Before meeting his brother Esau, Jacob says he is not worthy of all the kindness he has received. Gratitude and humility go together.

quotes.he: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל־אֶחָיו גְּשׁוּ־נָא אֵלַי וַיִּגָּשׁוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲנִי יוֹסֵף אֲחִיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־מְכַרְתֶּם אֹתִי מִצְרָיְמָה׃
quotes.tr: Vayomer yosef el-echav geshu-na elai vayigashu vayomer ani yosef achikhem asher-mekhartem oti mitzrayemah
quotes.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren: ‘Come near to me, I pray you.’ And they came near. And he said: ‘I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
quotes.why: Joseph says to the brothers who sold him, "Come close to me." It is one of the great moments of forgiveness in the Torah.

quotes.he: וְאַתֶּם חֲשַׁבְתֶּם עָלַי רָעָה אֱלֹהִים חֲשָׁבָהּ לְטֹבָה לְמַעַן עֲשֹׂה כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְהַחֲיֹת עַם־רָב׃
quotes.tr: Ve'atem chashavtem alai ra'ah Elohim chashavah letovah lema'an asoh kayom hazeh lehachayot am-rav
quotes.en: And as for you, ye meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
quotes.why: Joseph tells his brothers that what they meant for harm, God turned to good. Hard chapters of a life can lead somewhere good.

quotes.he: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־תִּקְרַב הֲלֹם שַׁל־נְעָלֶיךָ מֵעַל רַגְלֶיךָ כִּי הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה עוֹמֵד עָלָיו אַדְמַת־קֹדֶשׁ הוּא׃
quotes.tr: Vayomer al-tikrav halom shal-ne'alekha me'al raglekha ki hamakom asher atah omed alav admat-kodesh hu
quotes.en: And He said: ‘Draw not nigh hither; put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.’
quotes.why: At the burning bush Moses is told to take off his shoes, because the ground is holy. Some moments call for us to slow down and pay attention.

quotes.he: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל־מֹשֶׁה אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה וַיֹּאמֶר כֹּה תֹאמַר לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶהְיֶה שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם׃
quotes.tr: Vayomer Elohim el-Mosheh ehyeh asher ehyeh vayomer koh tomar livnei Yisra'el ehyeh shelachani aleikhem
quotes.en: And God said unto Moses: ‘I AM THAT I AM’; and He said: ‘Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel: I AM hath sent me unto you.’
quotes.why: Ehyeh asher ehyeh: "I will be what I will be." God's name here is about being present, in every time and place.

quotes.he: וְהִגַּדְתָּ לְבִנְךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר בַּעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְהוָה לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרָיִם׃
quotes.tr: Vehigadta levinkha bayom hahu lemor ba'avur zeh asah Adonai li betzeti mimitzrayim
quotes.en: And thou shalt tell thy son in that day, saying: It is because of that which the LORD did for me when I came forth out of Egypt.
quotes.why: This verse is why we tell the Passover story at the Seder. Each generation tells it as if it happened to them.

quotes.he: יְהוָה יִלָּחֵם לָכֶם וְאַתֶּם תַּחֲרִישׁוּן׃
quotes.tr: Adonai yilachem lakhem ve'atem tacharishun
quotes.en: The LORD will fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.’
quotes.why: At the Sea of Reeds, Moses tells the frightened people that God will fight for them. Sometimes the right move is to stay calm and trust.

quotes.he: עָזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ וַיְהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה זֶה אֵלִי וְאַנְוֵהוּ אֱלֹהֵי אָבִי וַאֲרֹמְמֶנְהוּ׃
quotes.tr: Azi vezimrat yah vayhi-li lishu'ah zeh eli ve'anvehu elohei avi va'aromemenhu
quotes.en: The LORD is my strength and song, And He is become my salvation; This is my God, and I will glorify Him; My father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
quotes.why: From the Song at the Sea: "The Lord is my strength and my song." These words are sung in synagogue every morning.

quotes.he: מִי־כָמֹכָה בָּאֵלִם יְהוָה מִי כָּמֹכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא׃
quotes.tr: Mi-khamokhah ba'elim Adonai mi kamokhah nedar bakodesh nora tehilot oseh fele
quotes.en: Who is like unto Thee, O LORD, among the mighty? Who is like unto Thee, glorious in holiness, Fearful in praises, doing wonders?
quotes.why: Mi chamocha, "Who is like You?" This line from the Song at the Sea is part of the daily prayers, just after the Shema.

quotes.he: וְאַתֶּם תִּהְיוּ־לִי מַמְלֶכֶת כֹּהֲנִים וְגוֹי קָדוֹשׁ אֵלֶּה הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר תְּדַבֵּר אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
quotes.tr: Ve'atem tihyu-li mamlekhet kohanim vegoy kadosh eleh hadevarim asher tedaber el-benei Yisra'el
quotes.en: and ye shall be unto Me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.’
quotes.why: At Sinai the whole people is called a kingdom of priests and a holy nation. Holiness is meant for everyone, not only for a few.

quotes.he: אָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃
quotes.tr: Anokhi Adonai Elohekha asher hotzetikha me'eretz Mitzrayim mibeit avadim
quotes.en: I am the LORD thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
quotes.why: The Ten Commandments begin with who God is: the One who brought us out of slavery. Freedom comes first, and the commandments follow.

quotes.he: זָכוֹר אֶת־יוֹם הַשַׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ
quotes.tr: Zakhor et-yom hashabat lekadesho
quotes.en: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
quotes.why: Zachor: "Remember the Shabbat day." We remember it with candles, Kiddush, rest and time with the people we love.

quotes.he: כַּבֵּד אֶת־אָבִיךָ וְאֶת־אִמֶּךָ לְמַעַן יַאֲרִכוּן יָמֶיךָ עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃
quotes.tr: Kabed et-avikha ve'et-imekha lema'an ya'arikhun yamekha al ha'adamah asher-Adonai Elohekha noten lakh
quotes.en: Honour thy father and thy mother, that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
quotes.why: Honour your father and your mother. It is one of the Ten Commandments, and the first that comes with a promise of long life.

quotes.he: וְגֵר לֹא־תוֹנֶה וְלֹא תִלְחָצֶנּוּ כִּי־גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃
quotes.tr: Veger lo-toneh velo tilchatzenu ki-gerim heyitem be'eretz Mitzrayim
quotes.en: And a stranger shalt thou not wrong, neither shalt thou oppress him; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
quotes.why: Do not wrong the stranger, because you were strangers in Egypt. This idea comes up again and again in the Torah.

quotes.he: לֹא־תִהְיֶה אַחֲרֵי־רַבִּים לְרָעֹת וְלֹא־תַעֲנֶה עַל־רִב לִנְטֹת אַחֲרֵי רַבִּים לְהַטֹּת׃
quotes.tr: Lo-tihyeh acharei-rabim lera'ot velo-ta'aneh al-riv lintot acharei rabim lehatot
quotes.en: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou bear witness in a cause to turn aside after a multitude to pervert justice;
quotes.why: Do not follow the crowd to do wrong. Doing the right thing sometimes means standing apart.

quotes.he: וְגֵר לֹא תִלְחָץ וְאַתֶּם יְדַעְתֶּם אֶת־נֶפֶשׁ הַגֵּר כִּי־גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃
quotes.tr: Veger lo tilchatz ve'atem yedatem et-nefesh hager ki-gerim heyitem be'eretz Mitzrayim
quotes.en: And a stranger shalt thou not oppress; for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
quotes.why: "You know the heart of the stranger." Our own history should make us kind to newcomers.

quotes.he: וְעָשׂוּ לִי מִקְדָּשׁ וְשָׁכַנְתִּי בְּתוֹכָם׃
quotes.tr: Ve'asu li mikdash veshakhanti betokham
quotes.en: And let them make Me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.
quotes.why: "Make Me a sanctuary, and I will dwell among them." Not "in it," but among them: God lives among people, in the places they make holy.

quotes.he: וְעַתָּה אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ הוֹדִעֵנִי נָא אֶת־דְּרָכֶךָ וְאֵדָעֲךָ לְמַעַן אֶמְצָא־חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה כִּי עַמְּךָ הַגּוֹי הַזֶּה׃
quotes.tr: Ve'atah im-na matzati chen be'einekha hodi'eni na et-derakhekha ve'eda'akha lema'an emtza-chen be'einekha ure'eh ki amekha hagoy hazeh
quotes.en: Now therefore, I pray Thee, if I have found grace in Thy sight, show me now Thy ways, that I may know Thee, to the end that I may find grace in Thy sight; and consider that this nation is Thy people.’
quotes.why: Moses asks God, "Show me Your ways, so that I may know You." Learning is one of the ways Jews come close to God.

quotes.he: וַיַּעֲבֹר יְהוָה עַל־פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא יְהוָה יְהוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת
quotes.tr: Vaya'avor Adonai al-panav vayikra Adonai Adonai el rachum vechanun erekh apayim verav-chesed ve'emet
quotes.en: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed: ‘The LORD, the LORD, God, merciful and gracious, long-suffering, and abundant in goodness and truth;
quotes.why: These are God's qualities of mercy, sung on the High Holy Days: compassionate, gracious, slow to anger, full of kindness and truth.

quotes.he: דַּבֵּר אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם קְדֹשִׁים תִּהְיוּ כִּי קָדוֹשׁ אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃
quotes.tr: Daber el-kol-adat benei-Yisra'el ve'amarta alehem kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai Eloheikhem
quotes.en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them: Ye shall be holy; for I the LORD your God am holy.
quotes.why: "You shall be holy, for I am holy." The chapter that follows shows what that means: honesty, kindness and fairness in everyday life.

quotes.he: אִישׁ אִמּוֹ וְאָבִיו תִּירָאוּ וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתֹתַי תִּשְׁמֹרוּ אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם׃
quotes.tr: Ish imo ve'aviv tira'u ve'et-shabetotai tishmoru ani Adonai Eloheikhem
quotes.en: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and ye shall keep My sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.
quotes.why: Respect your parents and keep Shabbat. Both are about honouring where we come from.

quotes.he: וּבְקֻצְרְכֶם אֶת־קְצִיר אַרְצְכֶם לֹא תְכַלֶּה פְּאַת שָׂדְךָ לִקְצֹר וְלֶקֶט קְצִירְךָ לֹא תְלַקֵּט׃
quotes.tr: Uvekutzrekhem et-ketzir artzekhem lo tekhaleh pe'at sadekha liktzor veleket ketzirekha lo telaket
quotes.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corner of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest.
quotes.why: Leave the corners of your field for people in need. Giving to others is built right into how we earn and spend.

quotes.he: לֹא־תְקַלֵּל חֵרֵשׁ וְלִפְנֵי עִוֵּר לֹא תִתֵּן מִכְשֹׁל וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃
quotes.tr: Lo-tekalel cheresh velifnei iver lo titen mikhshol veyareta me'Elohekha ani Adonai
quotes.en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling-block before the blind, but thou shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
quotes.why: Do not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block before the blind. Treat everyone with care, especially those who cannot defend themselves.

quotes.he: לֹא־תֵלֵךְ רָכִיל בְּעַמֶּיךָ לֹא תַעֲמֹד עַל־דַּם רֵעֶךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃
quotes.tr: Lo-telekh rakhil be'amekha lo ta'amod al-dam re'ekha ani Adonai
quotes.en: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people; neither shalt thou stand idly by the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
quotes.why: Do not spread gossip, and do not stand by while your neighbour is in danger. Words can hurt, and silence can too.

quotes.he: לֹא־תִקֹּם וְלֹא־תִטֹּר אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְאָהַבְתָּ לְרֵעֲךָ כָּמוֹךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃
quotes.tr: Lo-tikom velo-titor et-benei amekha ve'ahavta lere'akha kamokha ani Adonai
quotes.en: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
quotes.why: "Love your neighbour as yourself." Rabbi Akiva called this the great principle of the whole Torah.

quotes.he: מִפְּנֵי שֵׂיבָה תָּקוּם וְהָדַרְתָּ פְּנֵי זָקֵן וְיָרֵאתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶיךָ אֲנִי יְהוָה׃
quotes.tr: Mipenei seivah takum vehadarta penei zaken veyareta me'Elohekha ani Adonai
quotes.en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and thou shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
quotes.why: Rise before the elderly and honour them. Age brings wisdom, and the Torah asks us to show it respect.

quotes.he: וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּם אֵת שְׁנַת הַחֲמִשִּׁים שָׁנָה וּקְרָאתֶם דְּרוֹר בָּאָרֶץ לְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶיהָ יוֹבֵל הִוא תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם וְשַׁבְתֶּם אִישׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזָּתוֹ וְאִישׁ אֶל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ תָּשֻׁבוּ׃
quotes.tr: Vekidashtem et shenat hachamishim shanah ukeratem deror ba'aretz lekhol-yosheveha yovel hiv tihyeh lakhem veshavtem ish el-achuzato ve'ish el-mishpachto tashuvu
quotes.en: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land unto all the inhabitants thereof; it shall be a jubilee unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
quotes.why: "Proclaim liberty throughout the land." These words about the Jubilee year are cast on the Liberty Bell in Philadelphia.

quotes.he: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ׃
quotes.tr: Yevarekhkha Adonai veyishmerekha
quotes.en: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee;
quotes.why: The first line of the Priestly Blessing, still said in synagogues and by parents to children on Friday night.

quotes.he: יִשָּׂא יְהוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם׃
quotes.tr: Yisa Adonai panav elekha veyasem lekha shalom
quotes.en: The LORD lift up His countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
quotes.why: The Priestly Blessing ends with shalom, peace. In Hebrew, shalom also means wholeness: everything in its right place.

quotes.he: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מֹשֶׁה הַמְקַנֵּא אַתָּה לִי וּמִי יִתֵּן כָּל־עַם יְהוָה נְבִיאִים כִּי־יִתֵּן יְהוָה אֶת־רוּחוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם׃
quotes.tr: Vayomer lo Mosheh hamkane atah li umi yiten kol-am Adonai nevi'im ki-yiten Adonai et-rucho aleihem
quotes.en: And Moses said unto him: ‘Art thou jealous for my sake? would that all the LORD’S people were prophets, that the LORD would put His spirit upon them! ’
quotes.why: When others begin to prophesy, Moses is not jealous. He wishes everyone could share God's spirit. Great leaders lift others up.

quotes.he: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם אֹתוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹת יְהוָה וַעֲשִׂיתֶם אֹתָם וְלֹא־תָתֻרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּם זֹנִים אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃
quotes.tr: Vehayah lakhem letzitzit ure'item oto uzekhartem et-kol-mitzvot Adonai va'asitem otam velo-taturu acharei levavkhem ve'acharei eineikhem asher-atem zonim achareihem
quotes.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye go not about after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go astray;
quotes.why: This verse is about the tzitzit, the fringes on the tallit. Seeing them is a reminder of the commandments and of who we want to be.

quotes.he: מַה־טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
quotes.tr: Mah-tovu ohalekha Ya'akov mishkenotekha Yisra'el
quotes.en: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, Thy dwellings, O Israel!
quotes.why: Mah tovu, "How good are your tents." Many synagogues open the morning service with these words.

quotes.he: רַק הִשָּׁמֶר לְךָ וּשְׁמֹר נַפְשְׁךָ מְאֹד פֶּן־תִּשְׁכַּח אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר־רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וּפֶן־יָסוּרוּ מִלְּבָבְךָ כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ וְהוֹדַעְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְלִבְנֵי בָנֶיךָ׃
quotes.tr: Rak hishamer lekha ushemor nafshekha me'od pen-tishkach et-hadevarim asher-ra'u einekha ufen-yasuru milevavekha kol yemei chayekha vehodatam levanekha velivnei vanekha
quotes.en: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes saw, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life; but make them known unto thy children and thy children’s children;
quotes.why: Do not forget what you have seen, and teach it to your children and grandchildren. Memory is how a people stays alive.

quotes.he: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהוָה אֶחָד׃
quotes.tr: Shema Yisra'el Adonai Eloheinu Adonai echad
quotes.en: HEAR, O ISRAEL: THE LORD OUR GOD, THE LORD IS ONE.
quotes.why: The Shema, the central line of Jewish prayer: "Hear, O Israel, the Lord is our God, the Lord is One." It is said morning and night.

quotes.he: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶךָ׃
quotes.tr: Ve'ahavta et Adonai Elohekha bekhol-levavekha uvekhol-nafshekha uvekhol-me'odekha
quotes.en: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
quotes.why: V'ahavta: love God with all your heart, all your soul and all your strength. Faith in Judaism is about love, not only belief.

quotes.he: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶךָ׃
quotes.tr: Veshinantam levanekha vedibarta bam beshivtekha beveitekha uvelekhtekha vaderekh uveshakhbekha uvekumekha
quotes.en: and thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thy house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
quotes.why: Talk about these words at home, on the road, when you lie down and when you get up. That is why the Shema is said at bedtime and in the morning.

quotes.he: וַיְעַנְּךָ וַיַּרְעִבֶךָ וַיַּאֲכִלְךָ אֶת הַמָּן אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדַעְתָּ וְלֹא יָדְעוּן אֲבֹתֶיךָ לְמַעַן הוֹדִעֲךָ כִּי לֹא עַל־הַלֶּחֶם לְבַדּוֹ יִחְיֶה הָאָדָם כִּי עַל־כָּל־מוֹצָא פִי־יְהוָה יִחְיֶה הָאָדָם׃
quotes.tr: Vay'anekha vayar'ivekha vaya'akhilkha et haman asher lo-yadata velo yad'un avotekha lema'an hodi'akha ki lo al-halechem levado yichyeh ha'adam ki al-kol-motza fi-Adonai yichyeh ha'adam
quotes.en: And He afflicted thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that He might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every thing that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
quotes.why: "A person does not live by bread alone." We need meaning, learning and purpose as much as food.

quotes.he: וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָעְתָּ וּבֵרַכְתָּ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עַל־הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן־לָךְ׃
quotes.tr: Ve'akhalta vesava'eta uverakhta et-Adonai Elohekha al-ha'aretz hatovah asher natan-lakh
quotes.en: And thou shalt eat and be satisfied, and bless the LORD thy God for the good land which He hath given thee.
quotes.why: Eat, be satisfied, and bless. This verse is the source of Birkat Hamazon, the blessing after meals.

quotes.he: וַאֲהַבְתֶּם אֶת־הַגֵּר כִּי־גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃
quotes.tr: Va'ahavtem et-hager ki-gerim heyitem be'eretz Mitzrayim
quotes.en: Love ye therefore the stranger; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
quotes.why: Love the stranger, because you were strangers in Egypt. The Torah asks for more than not hurting newcomers; it asks us to love them.

quotes.he: צֶדֶק צֶדֶק תִּרְדֹּף לְמַעַן תִּחְיֶה וְיָרַשְׁתָּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ׃
quotes.tr: Tzedek tzedek tirdof lema'an tichyeh veyarashta et-ha'aretz asher-Adonai Elohekha noten lakh
quotes.en: Justice, justice shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
quotes.why: Tzedek tzedek tirdof: "Justice, justice you shall pursue." The word is said twice, to show how hard we should work for it.

quotes.he: כִּי־קָרוֹב אֵלֶיךָ הַדָּבָר מְאֹד בְּפִיךָ וּבִלְבָבְךָ לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ׃
quotes.tr: Ki-karov elekha hadavar me'od befikha uvilvavekha la'asoto
quotes.en: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
quotes.why: The Torah is not far away: it is in your mouth and in your heart. It is within reach, one word at a time.

quotes.he: הַעִידֹתִי בָכֶם הַיּוֹם אֶת־הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ הַחַיִּים וְהַמָּוֶת נָתַתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ הַבְּרָכָה וְהַקְּלָלָה וּבָחַרְתָּ בַּחַיִּים לְמַעַן תִּחְיֶה אַתָּה וְזַרְעֶךָ׃
quotes.tr: Ha'idoti vakhem hayom et-hashamayim ve'et-ha'aretz hachayim vehamavet natati lefanekha haberakhah vehakelalah uvacharta bachayim lema'an tichyeh atah vezar'ekha
quotes.en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that I have set before thee life and death, the blessing and the curse; therefore choose life, that thou mayest live, thou and thy seed;
quotes.why: "Choose life." Every day brings choices, and the Torah asks us to choose the ones that lead to life and blessing.

quotes.he: חִזְקוּ וְאִמְצוּ אַל־תִּירְאוּ וְאַל־תַּעַרְצוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם כִּי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הוּא הַהֹלֵךְ עִמָּךְ לֹא יַרְפְּךָ וְלֹא יַעַזְבֶךָּ׃
quotes.tr: Chizku ve'imtzu al-tir'u ve'al-ta'artzu mipeneihem ki Adonai Elohekha hu haholekh imakh lo yarpekha velo ya'azveka
quotes.en: Be strong and of good courage, fear not, nor be affrighted at them; for the LORD thy God, He it is that doth go with thee; He will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.’
quotes.why: Chazak ve'ematz: "Be strong and of good courage." Moses says this before the people enter the land without him.

quotes.he: וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל־לְבָבֶךָ׃
quotes.tr: Vehayu hadevarim ha'eleh asher anokhi metzavekha hayom al-levavekha
quotes.en: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be upon thy heart;
quotes.why: "These words shall be upon your heart." Learning Torah is meant to go deeper than memory, into who we are.

quotes.he: וְשָׁמְרוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת לְדֹרֹתָם בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃
quotes.tr: Veshamru venei-Yisra'el et-hashabat la'asot et-hashabat ledorotam berit olam
quotes.en: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
quotes.why: V'shamru: the people of Israel shall keep the Shabbat for all generations. This verse is sung on Friday night and Shabbat morning.

quotes.he: וְלֹא־קָם נָבִיא עוֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר יְדָעוֹ יְהוָה פָּנִים אֶל־פָּנִים׃
quotes.tr: Velo-kam navi od beyisra'el kemosheh asher yeda'o Adonai panim el-panim
quotes.en: And there hath not arisen a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face;
quotes.why: Near the very end of the Torah: no prophet arose like Moses, who knew God face to face. Then we roll the scroll back and start again.
